caption: The drawing depicts three black-and-white illustrations of a wall-mounted match safe labeled "THE VESTIBULE" with decorative elements at the top. Two of the match safes are mounted vertically on a surface, shown with a hand extending from the right side of each match safe, demonstrating a person accessing or operating the safes. The safes have hinged lids, small compartments, and rectangular shapes. Below, there is a rectangular tray or dustpan containing used match sticks, with another hand positioned next to it on the right, illustrating how to remove or manage spent matches. The drawing features textures and shading to illustrate the metallic look and depth of the objects. Below the illustrations, there is text describing the function, capacity, and usage of the match safe, including details about its ability to safely ignite matches and store used matches out of sight. The paper appears aged with visible stains and wear.
title: Match Safe "Vestibule"
